CONTEXT BEHIND THE NUMBERS

Data & methodology

Source-backed · no demonstration metrics

A fixed experiment

Nine integer features, scored 1–10. Sample IDs and actual labels are excluded from prediction. No missing feature values in the supplied matrices.

SOURCE DATACasosTrainTestWisconsin.matVERIFIED AGAINSTClasificador.mat

Check independence first

shared sample IDs

identical full rows appear in both partitions. Overlap can make evaluation optimistic; repeated IDs also need review.

Recommended next step

Deduplicate records, split by sample ID, then reevaluate before comparing models.

ƒ

Know what this measures

  • Categorical Naive BayesFrequency tables with Laplace smoothing (α = 1).
  • One supplied train/test splitNo repeated runs or external validation are included.
  • Explicit class conventionThe original script uses benign as positive. Here, malignant is positive.

This is an educational experiment, not a validated diagnostic tool. Model support is not a calibrated clinical risk estimate.
